notes.title: The siege tower & Steam Workshop update - September 20th 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It is already time for the third major Castle Creator update and this one is a big milestone:
[b]Full Campaign integration[/b] and [b]Steam Workshop[/b] support are here! You can now share,
download and use custom castles directly in your game.

[i]Sharing custom castles works the same way as units, but to use them in a campaign you must first enable them for the custom faction you are playing[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/ec682745ed027e9f02a834865b9971f95893050a.png[/img]

This update also introduces [b]siege towers[/b]. These can be enabled on walls in the Castle
Creator and will be built during quick battles or in your campaign. Siege battles as a whole
run smoother thanks to a round of optimizations aimed at the siege camp and custom castles.

There is plenty more packed in as well:
[list]
[*] New wall material variations
[*] A brand new [b]octagon tower[/b] type
[*] New props including doors, windows, chimneys, cranes and torches that react to time of day
[*] Expanded detail structures for keeps and towers
[*] Fresh siege camp graphics and new siege engine variations
[*] Landscape tools to round off and trim castle terrain
[/list]
There is still more work planned for the Castle Creator, but from here development will also
shift back toward other parts of the game. Stay tuned for the next updates!

[b]Thank you for all the support so far![/b]

[i]If you have suggestions, bugs or just general ideas for the next update, feel free to join the discord or drop by in the discussions. Always happy to hear your input.[/i]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/cTgXXfTmhc]https://discord.com/invite/cTgXXfTmhc
[/url]

notes.title: Castle Creator Update Pt. 2 - September 8th 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It is time for the second major Castle Creator update. This one expands both siege warfare and castle building in exciting new ways!

I have added dynamic destruction visuals for rooftops and wooden structures and brought back support for undermining the gatehouse. Siege rams have also been improved: You can now build castles with fully functional portcullis gates.

I also added throwable rock items that you can place around your castle. Units stationed near ladders on walls will automatically make use of these to defend more effectively.

This patch comes with many more fixes and improvements which you can read in the full list below.

After this patch the focus will be on improving what is there in addition to expanding the castle creator functionality and slowly enabling campaign use of the custom castles. When that is completed, it's time to allow sharing on the workshop!

notes.title: The Pacing Update Pt. 1 - July 30th 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Your feedback has reached me loud and clear. The majority of players want a more realistic experience, so I have started building towards that. First up is the game speed: [b]I lowered the entire game speed by 7.5 percent[/b] by default for a heavier feel in everything you do. On top of this, I added and [b]tweaked melee animations to provide a more grounded experience[/b]. [b]Player cavalry movement[/b] has also been improved to feel less arcade and much heavier. It will take a little while to get used to, but it is better than the instant turning you could do on a horse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/92c8c9b04a5b2285d2c9ed3b3d9da7d825eaddd6.jpg[/img]

This update also adds [b]realistic fire arrow smoke[/b]. Based on a video by Tod's Workshop, the smoke from fire arrows now actually resembles the nasty chemical burn seen in real life. This setting needs to be enabled in the performance section of the option menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/9beae08e3e186c352bc876549602ed618c0980fb.jpg[/img]

Finally, I added [b]fear reactions[/b] to units in certain situations. Units can flinch or freeze depending on context, for example large projectile impacts nearby, getting pummeled by fire arrows, or even getting hit by a heavily armored knight.

notes.title: The Loadout Update - June 13th 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This update overhauls how equipment is handled across the board. The new dynamic loadout system gives every unit and officer the flexibility to carry multiple weapons and swap between them based on situation and behavior. It also removes any unit specific battle stats and replaces them purely with equipment based stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/868ca74d415d8867a59b7eeb30f38535cfb398ef.jpg[/img]
Every unit now uses a modular equipment system, with weapons drawn from faction-defined loadout pools. Officers gain even more control through a new interface that lets you directly manage their gear in the campaign layer. Whether you want your commander mounted with a lance or armored with a danish axe, it’s now entirely in your hands.

The large army mode is now integrated in the campaign! It's still marked as experimental until all bugs are ironed out, but you can fully play campaigns with 7 formation garrisons now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/8fd48ab0c75b78186b6bfc2d62997808c52c9164.jpg[/img]

I've also added several key visual and balance improvements, see the full changelog below!

notes.title: The Flanders Update - May 5th 2025
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kS27T0HrBxY;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello everyone!

This update brings a major expansion to the campaign map, pushing deep into the southern Low Countries. With the inclusion of Flanders, Valkenburg, Loon and the town of Maastricht, the world of the game grows more complex, more contested, and more alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/a555985e18635c0c13316fb7d5bebd8fe5fdd32e.jpg[/img]  
[i]The new southern region of the campaign, featuring Maastricht and the heartlands of the Low Countries.[/i]

Flanders enters the war with its own distinct identity. Urban militias march alongside professional troops, and battlefield coordination is now enhanced with the addition of [b]signal units[/b]. These are trumpet bearers who actively sound commands during combat. They are physical, functional units that add presence and clarity to formation behavior in the heat of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/7893785bac80249d0b8508547a01f883fe01c752.jpg[/img]  
[i]Signal riders with banners and trumpets, straight out of a medieval manuscript.[/i]

Combat has also been sharpened at the edges. The new [b]dagger execution mechanic[/b] allows officers to finish vulnerable chainmail enemies in close quarters with a fast, grounded kill. It is not flashy. It is functional, and it reinforces the brutality of melee combat in a grounded way. 

[b]To use the new mechanic: [/b] [i]Press interact (E by default) when you see the indicator on a dehorsed, low health or unit of a broken formation. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/57066534c9bb935ae5917f6a190c3ccb25ad514b.jpg[/img]  
[i]The new dagger sheath, worn by an officer during a siege assault.[/i]

This update adds 14 new settlements, new battle maps, and a wide range of mechanical improvements. Whether you are taking your first steps into the south or reinforcing your campaign with new recruits, there is plenty here to explore.

This time another major update introducing a new diplomacy system! This patch also introduces several new mechanics, UI enhancements, and much-requested fixes, all aimed at making your experience more immersive and dynamic.

notes.title: The Sword Update - February 26th 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I’m excited to bring you another major update! This time, I’m introducing the Sword Editor, allowing you to craft custom swords with a variety of blade, guard, grip, and pommel combinations. This update expands the level of customization in the game, making it possible to create a wide variety of 13th century swords.

Alongside the sword editor, I’ve made several improvements to faction customization, horses, and overall visual polish while adding more historical detail to seasons and equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/c88ca1cada60721527bac1256fb0991e66783c07.jpg[/img]
[h2]The sword update[/h2]
By 1270, medieval knights relied on well-balanced swords designed to counter mail armor while remaining effective for cutting and thrusting. Swords of this period featured a variety of pommels, guards and shapes. Many swords bore inscriptions, including religious phrases like “In Nomine Domini” (“In the Name of the Lord”), maker’s marks, or mystical symbols believed to bring divine protection.

With the new Sword Editor, you can now recreate and customize these historical weapons in great detail!

[h3]⚔️ Sword Editor & Custom Swords[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fully-fledged Sword Editor
[*] Support for custom swords in battles, tournaments, and campaign mode
[*] Random swords now assigned to tournament contestants and officers
[/list]
[h3]🐴 Horse & Combat Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blood effects added to horses
[*] Improved horse colors
[*] Randomized horse colors
[/list]

[*] Improved faction customization
[*] Historical naming for seasons
[/list]

[*] Added confirmation dialogs when deleting customization files
[*] Improved sword meshes

notes.title: Voor De Kroon Update - September 6th 2024
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Today's update contains many improvements for your campaign experience and is the first of a couple of patches aimed at enhancing the campaign.

The update adds a flat map at the maximum zoom level. This will allow you to get a quick overview of the current game situation. It has three modes: Game Status, Ownership, and Town Heraldry. Switching is seamless and can be done with the press of a button or by simply zooming in and out.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/eef03ecb5d61aa3ed31b47c1bce3e6193208a93a.jpg[/img]

The patch also includes enhanced tooltips for resources, showing how they are influenced on a global scale. Camera controls are also improved, and you can now zoom out much further and travel faster based on your height.

The campaigns are split up again into the 'Friso-Hollandic Wars' and 'Conquer All' campaigns. This allows you to choose the preferred start safety and campaign length.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/93d9e8ebec79f8b998df4ac122e83756f7d3c354.jpg[/img]

[i]Some important things to know:[/i]
[list]
[*] A critical bug causing resaved custom campaigns to not be save game compatible has been fixed, all currently saved games are compatible with this version, only older save games from 2 weeks ago and prior will be broken
[*] Press TAB or controller Select/special left to switch map modes, alternatively you can zoom out far enough an dit will fade into it or press the button in the upper left corner
[*] Resource Tooltips have been enhanced, now showing where what resource comes from and what your global costs are
[*] The campaign is split up again in a conquer all and friso-hollandic campaign
[*] I fixed the last controller input issues, you can now scroll all windows with the right thumbstick and all content except the campaign editor is fully accessible
[*] Legacy savegames of the old campaign map are now permanently blocked and the content has been removed
[/list]

[i]Your feedback is always valuable so please share your thoughts![/i]

If you experience any issues or bugs, you can report them using the ingame feedback form, steam discussion or on the recently reopened official discord server.

[b]Join the discord here:[/b]
https://discord.com/invite/cTgXXfTmhc

notes.title: Voor de kroon update - August 26th 2024
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

I've got some exciting updates to share with you today! On a technical level, the biggest news is the [b]unification of all campaign logic[/b]. Before this update, there was a distinction between how custom campaigns and normal campaigns worked. They are now the same. You can even open the default campaign in the campaign editor to see how it was made.

In addition to this, I’ve improved the look of [b]water and winter effects[/b] and enhanced how height works to make custom and official campaign maps more beautiful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/c3abbed201173afcde8c85fe6695219ed8605a7a.jpg[/img]
[i]The new water and campaign landscape for official and unoffical campaigns.
[/i]

I've also greatly improved unit variety by introducing mixed weapons for a lot of units. For example, militia units now come equipped with melee weapons, bucklers, shields, and other equipment alongside their polearms. This creates a more realistic representation of a 13th-century medieval formation while maintaining their original battlefield functionality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/24391120d5196e16b2d5537949bb46edfc1b2075.jpg[/img]
[i]Greater unit variety in formations.[/i]


The update also introduces various configuration entries that you can tweak in the INI files, including [b]BATTLE SIZE[/b]. I know you’ve been asking for this! You can now raise a multiplier to increase formation sizes. Note that there is a technical limit of 5000 units—exceeding this will cause units to stand in place.

[b]WARNING: I DON'T OFFER SUPPORT FOR CUSTOM BATTLE SIZES. PERFORMANCE AND CRASHES CAN BE EXPECTED AT LARGE BATTLE SIZES.[/b]

[b]All options are below and should be added to the game.ini located in:[/b]
C:\Users[username]\AppData\Local\FormationSystem\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\game.ini 

[code][/Script/FormationSystem.FMConfig]
BattleSizePercentage=1.0
CavalryHealthMultiplier=1.0
CavalryDamageMultiplier=1.0
RangedDamageMultiplier=1.0
GlobalSpeedMultiplier=1.0
GlobalHealthMultiplier=1.0

MinUnitScale=0.96
MaxUnitScale=1.04
MinHorseScale=1.03
MaxHorseScale=1.05
LordUnitScale=1.05
WaterInfantrySpeedModifier=0.6
WaterCavalrySpeedModifier=0.5
AntiCavalryRearChance=0.7
AntiCavalryRearThreshold=2.0
AntiCavalryArrowDamageBonus=1.5
AntiCavalryArrowHorseRearChance=0.75
LadderDamageMultiplier=999999.0

EnemyDuelAcceptChanceEquals=0.35
EnemyDuelAcceptChanceUnequal=0.18
ArmySpawnDistance=23000.0
ArmySpawnDistanceSiege=19000.0
BattleWinMargin=0.1
BattleWinMarginSiegeAttacker=0.3
ReinforcementSpawnTime=80.0
ReinforcementSpawnTimeModifier=40.0[/code]

Finally, the [b]campaign editor[/b] has received significant upgrades and will continue to be improved as needed for official campaigns. Be sure to check it out if you enjoy creating your own campaigns!

[b]Thank you for all your support so far![/b]

If you experience any issues or bugs, you can report them using the ingame feedback form, steam discussion or on the recently reopened official discord server.

Join the discord here:
https://discord.com/invite/cTgXXfTmhc

notes.title: Combat Overhaul update - May 27th 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am excited to announce the release of the latest game update! This update completely overhauls most combat systems and adds in a stance based combat mode, updated mounted combat and updated tutorials. The update also contains a lot more polish, bugfixes and tweaks.

[previewyoutube=542AKWCka7I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The main features of this update are:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Stance based combat:[/b] Fight enemy officers and in tournaments using the new stance based fencing system. It's a directional combat system using 3 guards with the addition of kicks and stabs to break up the flow.
[*] [b]Improved mounted combat:[/b] You are no longer a static character on a horse and can fully rotate while attacking allowing for a greater variety in strikes and attacks. You can also stab from horses. Along with this the mounted AI has been improved with visible targeting.
[*] [b]Tutorials:[/b] This update adds an updated player controls tutorial and a battle tutorial that teaches the basics of commanding your formations.
[*] [b]Pre battle parley:[/b] A couple of prebattle options have been added, you can challenge enemy commanders to single combat, do an instant charge or start deploying your army.
[*] [b]UI Polish:[/b] A lot of battle UI elements have received an upgrade in clarity and polish smoothing out your game experience.
[/list]
Your feedback is really important in improving the game, so feel free to share all your thoughts on the new combat.

[b]Thank you for your continued support![/b]

notes.title: Campaign editor update - February 8th 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am thrilled to announce the release of my latest game update, which not only brings a host of enhancements and fixes but also introduces an exciting new feature that I've been working on for a while: the [b]Campaign Editor[/b]. This powerful tool is designed to unleash your creativity, allowing you to craft the medieval campaigns of your dreams. I will upload a guide soon detailing the basics of using the campaign editor and sharing your campaign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/9d1eba1fb56251c716e73def509f7a2d84cb89e2.jpg[/img]

[b]The main features of this update are:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Campaign Editor:[/b] Now you can create your own custom campaigns!
[*][b]Steam Workshop Support:[/b] Share your custom campaigns easily with others via the Steam Workshop.
[*][b]Workshop File Updates:[/b] Update existing files directly, making it simpler to improve your campaigns based on feedback or new ideas.
[*][b]Skin Color Support:[/b] All units now have skin color customization options.
[*][b]New Landscapes:[/b] Fight across desert valleys, gravel deserts, and mountainous terrains.
[*][b]Unit Size Variation:[/b] All recruited units will now have a slightly different amount of units, making the battles feel more realistic.
[*][b]UI Improvements:[/b] Increased visibility for various battle UI elements and added army size numbers at the start of battles.
[*][b]Settlement Interface Enhancements:[/b] New details about total garrison size and ready garrison size now included.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/baf833efb25693c79fd63fecdd2f8faf906520f1.jpg[/img]

I've also made several fixes and improvements across the board to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

Your feedback has been invaluable, and I am excited to see what you'll create and share with the new Campaign Editor. 

[b]Thank you for your continued support![/b]

If you run into any issues/crashes or have suggestions, always feel free to let me know!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/d5d2895450b2242b65713fc270a543819f8f833d.png[/img]

Hello Everyone!

I am thrilled to roll out a significant update that brings a host of new features and improvements to "Voor de kroon". Dive in to discover the latest enhancements!

[h3]🛡 Faction Customization Overhaul:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Create and Customize:[/b] Design new factions from the ground up. From the appearance of your lord to the buildings your faction can erect – the choice is now yours!
[*][b]Heraldry Import:[/b] Take your faction personalization a step further by importing custom image assets for heraldry. For a step-by-step guide on how to seamlessly integrate your emblem textures, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3066380941]Custom Heraldry Import Guide[/url].
[*][b]Expanded Capabilities:[/b] Choose specific units for recruitment, replace any existing faction with a custom one, and enjoy an advanced character system for lords and officers with random equipment and appearance features.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/6ddbf42c5150952304a9c2ed8237aee29f11c55f.png[/img]

[h3]🗣 Dynamic Voice System Enhancement:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Voice Sets Diversity:[/b] Introducing three distinct voice sets, elevating the in-game atmosphere. Players will find two Dutch and one English voice set for a richer auditory experience.
[*][b]Linguistic Fidelity:[/b] Officers now randomly draw from their faction's allowed voice sets. This allows factions to actually have different spoken languages on the battlefield!
[/list]

[h3]🛡 New Armor & Models:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Historical Accuracy:[/b] All feudal armor is revamped to be era-appropriate, introducing a variety of new helmets, chainmail armor, and even painted helmets for units.
[/list]

[h3]🌦 Additional Features & Enhancements:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Weather Dynamics:[/b] Experience battles under a semi-clouded sky.
[*][b]Ultra-Quality Lighting:[/b] For those seeking to burns their computer to the ground, there is now an ultra-quality lighting option.
[*][b]Loading Screen Wisdom:[/b] Tips have been updated to match the current gameplay mechanics.
[/list]

[h3]🔧 Technical Improvements & Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Faction Framework:[/b] A complete rewrite now supports full customization.
[*][b]Fixed Gameplay Issues:[/b] Several bugs and small improvements have been made.
[/list]

Your feedback plays a crucial role in the development of Voor de Kroon. 
Share your thoughts, feedback, or questions in the discussion section. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 11th 2023 - Campaign overhaul
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]

I am thrilled to announce the latest update to Voor de kroon. 

[b][u]1. Revamped Building Upgrade System[/u][/b]
Delving deeper into the heart of medieval settlements, I've redefined the building upgrade mechanism.

[b]- Slot-Specific Upgrades:[/b] No longer can you build everything all over the place. You now need to adapt ot specific settlement biomes like forests, dunes and coastal areas.
[b]- Rebalanced economy:[/b] All buildings now have multiple effects and will need to be balanced out to create a good income stream to finance your wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/afbaa7dc5b60f5983718c9d2d729ee6dadaa9943.jpg[/img]


[b][u]2. Heraldry for All Settlements, and other campaign changes[/u][/b]
Every settlement in the low countries now boasts its unique heraldry.

[b]- Settlement heraldry:[/b] All settlements now have their own unique heraldry that is also displayed in battle by it's troops. When you move units they will retain their origin and still display from where they were called to arms simulating a lance system within the games context.
[b]- Better UI feedback:[/b] You can now exactly see what influences public order and settlement income when you hover over the respective stats. The settlement UI is also completely revamped providing a better user experience and a lower barrier of entry for new players.
[b]- Officer importance:[/b] Officers are now more important than ever, they have gained a loyalty stat that influences the unit morale and they hold the progress to the next unit rank. If they die in battle this progress is lost.
[b]- Updated campaign map:[/b] The campaign map has been updated to be a better reflection of the low countries during the 13th century and 5 settlements have been added to the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/d7c76289ba7b06f2cb4b368fbace5fd66dacfea7.jpg[/img]


[b][u]4. Battle AI improvements[/u][/b]
Battles are the heart and soul of the game and will always receive some love.

[b]- anti cavalry:[/b] Opponents will now dynamically use their infantry to counter your cavalry, especially with polearm formations this can provide a real challenge to overcome for your units.
[b]- cavalry movement:[/b] Cavalry will no longer get stuck behind silly things like trees and I improved the steering and movement speed of all cavalry for a more realistic battle experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/1011594bf80addf40c9912c52fd2f9b4d82f5a97.jpg[/img]

I am excited to see your feedback on this new update!

- Updated campaign map: The campaign map has been updated to be a better reflection of the low countries during the 13th century and 5 settlements have been added to the map.
- anti cavalry: Opponents will now dynamically use their infantry to counter your cavalry, especially with polearm formations this can provide a real challenge to overcome for your units.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 19th 2023 - Let there be castles!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=yRiumsb4m-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone,

This time an exciting update introducting stone castles and extended sieging mechanics to the game. The update adds 2 new castle type and revamps the wooden castle by adding raised dirt mounds like the test version had.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/be3ebd7bce6cd37ce1cea8e5e6e47d8ea5d96582.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/4db81e5cf0d1d10fa096500c404ed4bd15aaa017.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/eab1d0c73a70d75efbddb563cf2cfe67178bf14b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/8a3d5aafec88448523b373709eed1029d3326b0e.jpg[/img]

[b]Siege changes[/b]
Siege battles have been revamped and now feature 3 different types of castles. Each castle features 3 damage levels that occur when being sieged with a trebuchet during the camapign, this is also selectable from the quick battle menu, destruction levels will never fully breach the walls and only do visual damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/a359b2ee3174e2ee678734a1c36b1b016f63a2b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Sapping[/b] is now a really strong option to bring down the front wall of the castle and charge in directly.  This can be combined with ladders for an assault from all directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/82c440d87ab7c219bf51a4d8f41404f862ee287f.jpg[/img]


[b]Campaign[/b]
Castles now have a central role in the campaign and will take time to besiege, forming an actual challenge to overcome. You first have to lay siege to a settlement which will take one season and costs 10 wood. This will take the settlement hostage and deplete their food storage every season. When the food storage is depleted attrition will kick in and units inside the settlement will slowly start to die. Choosing when and how to attack will have a big impact on how you charge into battle and if you will charge at all or just wait for them to starve enough to surrender.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/d93718e26bf53df012628ba7b737726d42dd67c3.jpg[/img]


[b]Misc[/b]
This update also contains a lot of other changes like being able to rename officers and settlements and officers aging every year. The look of the campaign map has also improved and the map feels a lot larger now. You can find all the changes in the patch notes!

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 21st 2023 - Cavalry Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

This time an exciting update addressing cavalry movement and behaviors during battle. Horses have received a huge upgrade to their movement and don't stop and turn in place anymore during battles. The cavalry movement still has some bugs and odd behaviors that will be ironed out over the next updates, but overall it's a huge improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/173509c5012e18552eadec3add0573bcb124ec95.jpg[/img]

This update also contains a lot of fixes and quality of life improvements. Polearm infantry has received a big upgrade making them able to decimate the most elite cavalry units when the conditions are right. Friendly units are outlined during the deployment phase and when the formation interface is opened. Units are made slightly more generic to deceive your eyes more, making the armies feel less cloned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/261b4691ac197907fdc51fbd10225481cd6ac8be.jpg[/img]

You can now also cycle formation shapes when having a formation selected in the same way as during deployment by using the spacebar/left trigger. You can confirm the new space by moving the formation.

Thank you for all the support so far! I am excited to show what I am working on for the next updates.

notes.title: Updated game roadmap for 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I want to present the updated roadmap for the remainder of 2023. The game has come a long way already thanks to your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/f6a24c773386cf9b469f98b8a4f2844649912ade.png[/img]

[h2][b]Extended customization options[/b][/h2]
The game will steer towards a user content driven ecosystem. This allows players to customize their experience and create campaigns and factions. Want to create a custom campaign set in france? Done. 

[h2][b]Stone castles[/b][/h2]
Currently there are 2 tiers of fortifications, both with wooden walls. Stone castles are planned and currently worked on and will have you siege actual medieval fortresses using ladders, trebuchets and stormrams.

[h2][b]Gameplay and interface work[/b][/h2]
The game will receive continues updates to the gameplay and UX. The game has already improved a LOT since launch and will continue to do so.

I am looking forward to improving the game and adding features and content. The road to 1.0 is long, but I am excited to be on this path with you.

If you have questions or something to share let me know in the comments!

Thank you!

Kevin

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 3rd 2023 - Tournaments Alpha
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TqQThtMJpbk;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Everyone!

This update integrates tournaments into the game that are available as quick battles and randomly occur during the campaign. It also includes new weather wetness and wind effects and various fixes and improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/1c5f36025e7de1ad49461c41cd0b8507e82f0aa8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/e3543af04d047b7fc712f6130cef99e7d259af49.png[/img]
There are also two new units added to the game. 'Vlaminc' which are flemish mercenaries equipped with a crossbow and a goededag as sidearm. They have the same properties are skirmishers and are excellent melee fighters and won't route easily. Another new unit is the elite knight on foot, they fight with 1.5 handers and are a force to be reckoned with.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/e3a51b050baa7268e8382559e5146f50a1e99844.jpg[/img]
You can play jousting and melee tournaments in quick battles and select how you want to play. You can play a small tournament or a single battle and choose the weapons you want to use. In the campaign tournaments can randomly popup as a game event if you are playing as a feudal lord(non frisian) and you can choose to join the tournament allowing you to earn reputation with the ohers lords. On realism mode tournaments only popup during summer and spring with sunny weather, on cinematic mode they can popup in all seasons and weather types.


So is it all doom and gloom? [b]No, not at all.[/b] The new patch contains way brigther summer and spring colors for realism mode really bringing out the summer feel. This patch improves the look and feel of all weather types overall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/b8cc7105e2a87901fd2dbef62e5f5b73c871c3c0.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoy it. For suggestions, comments or problems: drop a post in the discussions.

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes - July 12th 2023 - Campaign Update pt. 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, [u]this is the last day you can save 20% on Voor de Kroon during the steam summer sale[/u]!

This update contains a complete overhaul of the campaign diplomacy and interaction with other factions. The decree screen and throneroom are completely removed and you will stay on the campaign map after every turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/1fb65fead475e8f1855b63303fd734c92a23f28c.jpg[/img]

Diplomacy is now based on bargaining resources and success percentages. There is also a persistant stat that keeps track of positive interactions that will help in the bargaining process.

You can now also send envoys to a friendly faction and peacefully annexate them when you have stationed enough envoys. On the other side you can send spies to hostile factions, when caught the enemy faction will turn permanently hostile preventing you from doing any diplomatic deals with them. When you have succesfully infiltrated you can attempt to assasinate the enemy lord. Each spy increases the chance of a succesful assassination. 

If the assasination attempt fails all factions will cut off diplomatic relations with you. So it's a high risk, high reward manoeuvre.

There are also a variety of fixes and improvements and I hope you will enjoy the new update.

Thank you for all the support!

Kevin

[h2]Armor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/ad2baca49123c152dea54bd256f9c2990387df7d.png[/img]
All militia units are now wearing new armor, there are still some updates coming up to the models with some cool archeological findings from the low countries.


[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
This update also contains a lot of gameplay changes. Formation charge behavior has been revampled completley and now connects correctly from all angles. Formations spacing has been revamped: low level units now have a bigger spacing than before and high level units a tighter spacing greatly increasing cohesion and combat effectiveness. Fighting now takes into account a height advantage giving a damage bonus to units on higher ground. 

Polearm units are now far more deadly against cavalry making them a viable option in your army. This goes along with the removal of the overpowered chainmail based polearm units that feudal factions had. 


[h2]Ranged Units[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/99992799ab932df3170cb19dabe38de80d62b19d.jpg[/img]
The frisians have a new skirmisher unit that uses throwing spears and operates at close distance. Spears can penetrate shields and can be thrown in rapid succession at the enemy. When drawn into melee or out of projectiles they can stand their ground very well in combat with a spear and shield combination. Watch out for these guys!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/ff39fd972a0d244772d61aa1dce4d0a1153bf623.png[/img]
Ranged units now have limited ammo and a revamped set of firing modes. When ammo is depleted the archer formation will behave as a melee formation. Ranged formations start in a new selective fire mode that only targets formations that are not near friendly units preventing friendly fire. You can cycle through fire modes to set them to forced fire, this will make them target enemy formations even when close to friendly formations or hold fire. 


[h2]Cinematic and Realism mode[/h2]
[previewyoutube=v5nAVZ8oBng;full][/previewyoutube]
When starting up the game you will be presented with a choice between two gameplay modes. These are a certain combination of gameplay settings also accessible through the options menu that allow you to shape the gameplay to your liking. You can always select a new mode through the options menu.


[b]Thank you[/b] for all the support so far, stay tuned for more updates. Next up are the armors of the knights!

If you have bugs, questions, complaints or anything, let me know in the discussions!

[u]This update is due to shifted unit offsets not compatible with previous savegames.[/u]

notes.title: Commander Update - May 18th 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This update adds the ability to designate a garrison commander which you will play as in battle and the on foot controls for the player are greatly improved.

[b]Commander System[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/57bfea283f2ef261da1774a46b4693328ac1e720.jpg[/img]
Each garrison now has a designated commander which you will play as in battle. You can appoint an officer as commander through their unit detail screen and choose wether you will spawn mounted or on foot.

[b]On foot controls[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/0c1260af1c0cbd85c2997b96e1062078fdf3a0bf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Siege battle campaign integration update - May 15th 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

There are a lot of big changes in this exciting new update! Among the visible updates are a lot of under the hood mechanical changes that open up the game to exciting new possibilites and more dynamic battle landscapes.

[b]Hotfix incoming for campaign building crashes and some other small things. Thank you for your patience![/b]

[b]Siege battles[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/96772435127271fcb0627050b4baa1af2531536d.jpg[/img]
This updates integrates a first iteration of siege battles into the campaign gameplay loop. You can build two tiers of fortifications: A wooden tower and a stone tower. These will spawn fortifications in battle when attacked. 

You can storm the fortifications using storm ladders and a storm ram and try to gain entry inside. The AI is adjusted specifically for the siege battles and will try to move towards interest points when charging rather than a specific formation. You will need to build an engineers quarter or siege workshop before you can siege a fortified settlement.

[b]Combined battle maps[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/7bd18ea1a10f620c9a4cf6900fd53f2fb75077f6.jpg[/img]
All battle maps are now directly based on the campaign map and contain multiple settlements per map. So instead of a seperate map for each settlement you fight in large scale environments, there is always something on the horizon if not sea.

[b]Wood resource[/b]
During the campaign you will use a different resource for siege engines. You can produce wood by building forestry huts and lumberyards. 

Each ladder costs 1 wood
Stormram costs 12 wood
Trebuchet costs 15 wood
Stakes cost 2 wood
Archer defenses cost 2 wood
Fire arrows cost 1 wood

[b]Your ruler is also a unit[/b]
You ruler is now also a unit in a garrison. You can now keep him safe while fighting with a lower level officer in battles. You can also send him to the front lines for 'high risk, high reward' gameplay.

[b]The future of the game[/b]
There is a lot of cool stuff in development right now including a historically accurate armor set which is well underway and more historical architecture. Stone castles are coming to the siege battles and expect a lot of fixes and optimizations to the general gameplay loop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/4db3d63ff4fb64ac2841e7c03e27af9dfbe2d918.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you for playing! [/b]

If you encounter issues, bugs or don't like new features. Let me know in the steam discussions or on discord!

https://discord.gg/Sd3XF8nq2h

notes.title: Reinforcements and Tactics Update - April 21st 2023
notes.content:
Hello all,

This update adds the ability to select renforcements to come to your aid from neighbouring settlements. You can now also choose what to do with surviving enemy officers after a battle. You can hire, release or execute them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/dbcbdac0c98204fae0e00783139a9f415b9468b1.png[/img]

This update also implement deployment tactics for AI armies. The enemy will deploy his army in a way to makes sense to his army composition. This system will be refined over the coming period. The enemy army is now hidden until you have finished deploying.

The siege battle test has been disabled in preparation for the full scale rollout. More on this soon!

[*] Add prebattle screen to select reinforcements for upcoming battle

notes.title: Patch Notes March 11th, 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This update revamps unit movement allowing infantry a far wider moveset in battle. This makes battles feel more dynamic. The health and armor of units is also updated to better reflect differences between armored and non armored units. These changes make infantry battles drastically more fun to participate in and make the battlefield feel more realistic and alive. I also tweaked some attack distances to make formations wrap around and properly engage eachother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/153d0263d06036aad99d7fbb6843d007cb03afc4.jpg[/img]

Units now also utilize their polearms better against cavalry. A dedicated spear bracing mechanic has been implemented. If a formation is left idle with enemy cavalry near they will assume a spear brace pose. When fighting or not in a spear brace pose spear units are just as effective against cavalry as normal infantry. This nerfs spearmen while at the same time making them more deadly when used correctly.

There is also a lot of stuff being worked on behind the scenes and I can't wait to tell you more about it! I am spending a lot of time working on getting the siege battles ready for a campaign rollout.

Thank you!

notes.title: Siege Battle Test update 30 January 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Sorry for the long wait! To make siege battles possible I had to rewrite how units collide and move around, but you can expect more regular updates again.

This updates include a tier 1 fortification siege battle in the skirmish mode. You can access it from the skirmish menu. It also includes, among other things, a level system, stat tracking and more permanence for lance sergeants. It also implements the first of many historically accurate assets to come, a 13th century romanesque church made by a talented 3d modeler. 

Some heraldry emblems have, in advance to a big heraldry update, received a new look. A heraldic artist, that knows a lot about the 13th century low countries, has created new emblems for Holland and Gelre that are more in line with heraldry that was used during this era.

The tutorial campaign is disabled for now as the information given was starting to get behind pretty far on the actual developments on the game. I need to find a way to distribute gameplay information to new players in a way that grows more organically with the game.

[previewyoutube=SI1wyl51wOQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Siege battles[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/1d43c24ad3baa771316f089b0ce2c87f981a3405.jpg[/img]

This update lays the foundations for siege battles. You can create siege engines and attach formations to them to assault enemy castles and fortifications. When in a siege you win by eliminating all enemy formations. Damaging the castle itself will still give a morale penalty to the defenders.

Expect this to be a experimental gamemode for now. You will encounter bugs and odd behavior. Reporting this will always be appreciated!

[b]Unit level system[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/49c377222479d89da95c061857fcd0c16e05dc5d.jpg[/img]

Units now earn experience for kills and battles fought. When recruiting new units their placement will be sloppy and they won't fight optimally. When progressing towards level 5 they will start holding a tigther formation and fight better. Units now also save the amount of deaths they have suffered and will muster 10% of new recruits per season. 

You can access unit details along with their level progress by right clicking a unit and selecting unit details. You can still transfer units from the unit detail screen.

[b]Ranged unit sidearms[/b]
Instead of fleeing, Ranged units will now draw a sidearm and stand their ground. When a ranged unit has their sidearm drawn they will behave as a melee formation.

notes.title: Cosmetic and command update 4 January 2022
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This time a rather big update again. First of all I hope that this update fixes the biggest battle issues that were present including vague or missing UI elements and morale not working correctly. Secondly this update features a host of cosmetic changes including new unit models and more natural animations. 

The bad news: 
Save games and settings are unfortunately incompatible due to the volume of unit changes so your user settings will be reset completely when starting the game with the new update.

[previewyoutube=mxRkkcxSSTk;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]The new units[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/f168e32a307ae8c691a776c458ebac2918100c13.png[/img]

I was not happy with the way units looked until now and I wanted to get rid of them as soon as possible. I choose to dig in and create a 'between step' for the cosmetic side of the game to atleast give the units the right clothing for the era and take a step into the right direction of what I am aiming for with the game.


[b]Animations[/b]
Crossbows and archer units have received the biggest update. Crossbow now actually reload their crossbow and archers actually fire arrows and actually draw their bows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/a939d4487d1ce8603d079c19a2011b5c211022c9.jpg[/img]

I also updated the stance and locomotion animations of all melee units making them look way more natural. The last traces of the spinning sword attacks are also out.


[b]Battle updates[/b]
This update contains lots of fixes regarding the battle flow and commanding. Units now actually listen when you tell them to charge and morale is now more balanced fixing issues with instantly routing armies. The enemy lord will now only be wounded and flee the battlefield when enough damage is done, it was a bit strange decapitating a lord several times over several battles. 

The interface now shows the unit positions when moving a unit and the unit you are about to attack when the marker is near an enemy formation. I also added a balance bar to the bottom of the screen indicating the general morale balance between the two armies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/01e454546a33c99ce77a0f5e98fe71fe438ae3bf.jpg[/img]

For the next update I will focus on campaign mechanics, especially the sergeant/lance system.

[u]Thank you[/u] for playing and all the support!

notes.title: Combat control update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The latest update revamps player movement. One of the most common heard complaints was a lot of players finding it difficult to control the player.

[previewyoutube=wwuF5sPqoI4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Player Control[/b]
This new update contains massive control and gameplay improments both on horse and on foot. You now control your horse with your keyboard allowing you to freely look around with the mouse. Combat on foot is more tight but also more claustrophobic giving a tense feeling of close combat.

It's now also possible to switch to a two handed stance(1.5 handed technically) by pressing draw secondary while on foot. I increased the size of the hilt of the standard sword for now, but when the sword customization is implemented this will only be possible with 1.5 handed hilts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/40b515ae9fa9895785ee9bdeded9d9e491a21326.jpg[/img]

[b]Flags[/b]
This update adds in a new 'extreme' flags option. It's heavy on the CPU, but it gives all knights flags.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/fd89d8dd3b3d8340a97eacef3732b2d454db3426.jpg[/img]

[b]Campaign[/b]
All settlements now have a 3d mesh representing their fortification level. It's pretty basic for now, but it feels better than only having a floating shield. 

It's now only possible to transfer units to connected settlements or through friendly territory. This changes the way you can move your army across the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/5342393f7ff20240b117920ffc54fb050fc8728d.jpg[/img]

The patch notes of 28 December contain the full list of changes from this update.

I hope you all had a good week! And I will see you next year.

Thank you for all the support so far!

notes.title: Patch Notes 23 December 2022 - Big user feedback update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This patch contains updated in game post processing (More colors!), Better unit control and Graafschap Gelre is now a playable lord in the campaign. First the bad news, your key bindings will be reset and your campaign save is incompatible, now onto the good news!

I got a [u]lot[/u] of feedback on the gray filter and the army command controls with keyboard an mouse. I have put a lot of work into fixing these and I think it's coming along nicely. 

[b]First up, the unit control interface:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/bca2c7ae768fccb3ea48bac1a36ba633106ddca2.png[/img]

With this new update you can control your army by directly selecting units with the 1 - 5 number keys and issue orders with the F1 to F6 keys. The TAB button now functions as a formation status lookup and shows all unit cards with their status when held. 

This new system also brings the added benefit of greatly enhanced battlefield clarity. You can now see the type of unit, the amount of units alive, the morale status and what the formation is doing in real time. This way you can easily see if your plan is working out!

[b]Second, the colors[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/631a8f152d7bae80e2efd7e89d579dae46ac0668.jpg[/img]
This is what an overcast day looks like in the new patch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/06ba61d34f1e33391da9cefff2c47b55260e028f.jpg[/img]
Second showcase shot, also showcasing the new mercenary units for Bisdom Utrecht.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865338/48d56b36de9c96f1f73329bfcf54a8c0fff78439.jpg[/img]
Graaf Reinoud I in his new outfit.

The light level is also boosted on rainy days providing more visual clarity. On top of this all I increased the chance of clear weather with 15%, because apparently some people can't get used to the dutch climate. ;)

Oh and I almost forgot. I started working on the tutorials, right now I've added a basic training tutorial. It's a short and sweet tutorial on how to operate your lord on the battlefield. An army commanding tutorial will be coming too.

[b]Full change log:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add 15% extra chance of clear weather
[*] Fix typo in loading screen
[*] Fix floating house in Alkmaar
[*] Increase Frisian infantry strength against cavalry (now at 2.5x, was 1.5x, more on faction balance later! Tip for now, frisians are best at fighting on foot, you need to reverse the logic for their unit types)
[*] Raise base flee threshold for fanatic cavalry
[*] Change Kennemer army culture
[*] add savefile versioning to check compatibility with new patches
[*] Remove old global hold fire command
[*] Fix unit rotation while issueing orders: units now maintain rotation except when charging and moving directly
[*] Fix water plants dissapearing in winter

[*] Add basic training
[*] Increase size of horses by ~5%
[*] Enable arrow trails by standard
[*] Fix player blood resetting on dismount

[*] Make post processing less desatured
[*] Boost light levels

[*] Fix player dismounting when issueing orders
[*] Add decal to trebuchet impact
[*] Fix rippling water on mounted attack

[*] Implement custom faction culture for Utrecht
[*] Improve LOD's across all characters (CPU perf increase)
[*] Add Gelre to playable lords in Campaign
[*] Fix trebuchet water impact
[/list]

For now, happy holidays everyone, see you next year! 

Thank you for all the support so far.
